## 2. Exhaustive Commodity Catalogs & Technical Data Sheets (TDS)

### Product 1: Cold-Pressed Virgin Coconut Oil (VCO)
- **Canonical URL:** https://rbnexim.com/product-virgin-coconut-oil.html
- **HS Code:** 15131100
- **Extraction Protocol:** Wet-milling and cold centrifuge extraction directly from fresh, mature grated coconut milk. Strictly cold-pressed without heating above 45°C.
- **Chemical & Physical Specifications:**
  - Free Fatty Acids (FFA as Lauric): < 0.10% (Export Grade A)
  - Moisture Content: < 0.10%
  - Lauric Acid (C12:0): 49.5% – 53.2%
  - Peroxide Value (PV): < 0.5 meq O2/kg
  - Iodine Value: 6.0 – 9.0
  - Saponification Value: 250 – 265 mg KOH/g
  - Appearance: Water-clear liquid (>24°C) / Pure snow-white crystalline solid (<24°C)
  - Aroma: Mild, fresh natural raw coconut aroma; 100% free from rancidity, smoke, or burnt notes.
- **Packaging & Logistics:**
  - 200 Liter Food-Grade Virgin HDPE Drums (190 kg net)
  - 1000 Liter Intermediate Bulk Containers (IBC Totes / 920 kg net)
  - 20ft ISO Flexibags / Flexitanks (21.5 Metric Tons net)
  - Private label glass & PET bottling available for retail container orders.
- **Primary Industrial Applications:** Functional food, nutraceutical capsules, cosmetic emollient, premium soap bases, baby care formulations, pharmaceutical excipients.

---

### Product 2: Expeller Pressed Coconut Oil (Milling & Edible Grade)
- **Canonical URL:** https://rbnexim.com/product-coconut-oil.html
- **HS Code:** 15131900
- **Extraction Protocol:** Mechanical screw-press extraction from sun-dried edible ball copra half cups sourced from Tiptur, double filtered through filter press cloths.
- **Chemical & Physical Specifications:**
  - Free Fatty Acids (FFA as Lauric): < 0.8% – 1.0%
  - Moisture & Insoluble Impurities: < 0.20%
  - Peroxide Value: < 1.0 meq O2/kg
  - Color (Lovibond 1/4" cell): Y < 2.0, R < 0.3
  - Specific Gravity (30°C): 0.915 – 0.920
  - Refractive Index (40°C): 1.448 – 1.450
- **Packaging & Logistics:** 200L Steel Drums, 1000L IBCs, 20ft Flexitanks (21 Metric Tons).
- **Primary Applications:** Commercial food frying, confectionery fats, industrial soap manufacturing, hair oil base, oleochemical fatty acids.

---

### Product 3: Premium Tiptur Copra (Dried Coconut Half Cups)
- **Canonical URL:** https://rbnexim.com/product-copra.html
- **HS Code:** 12030000
- **Geographic Sourcing:** Sourced exclusively from Tiptur, Karnataka—known globally as the highest-oil coconut belt in South Asia.
- **Grades Available:**
  1. **Edible Grade (Ball Copra):** Whole round cups, pristine white-to-light cream meat, sweet taste, zero mold, sulfur-free.
  2. **Milling Grade (Grade A Half Cups):** Sun-dried copra halves optimized for oil extraction efficiency.
- **Technical Specifications:**
  - Oil Content (Dry Basis): > 68.0% (Reaching up to 71% in peak season)
  - Moisture Content: < 5.5% – 6.0% (Guarantees zero mold growth during sea transit)
  - Free Fatty Acid (FFA): < 1.0%
  - Damaged / Discolored Cups: < 1.5%
  - Foreign Matter: < 0.25%
- **Packaging & Logistics:** 25 kg, 40 kg, and 50 kg high-tensile breathable polypropylene (PP) woven bags. 20ft FCL holds ~12–14 MT; 40ft High Cube holds ~24–26 MT.

---

### Product 4: Coconut Shell Charcoal Granulated Chips
- **Canonical URL:** https://rbnexim.com/product-charcoal-chips.html
- **HS Code:** 44029010
- **Manufacturing:** High-temperature carbonization of clean, seasoned mature coconut shells in controlled masonry kilns.
- **Technical Parameters:**
  - Fixed Carbon Content: > 75.0% – 82.0%
  - Ash Content: < 3.0%
  - Moisture: < 7.0%
  - Volatile Matter: 12.0% – 15.0%
  - Hardness Index: > 98.0%
  - Particle Granulation: Standard 3x8 mesh, 4x8 mesh, or custom client sizing.
- **Packaging:** 50 kg woven PP sacks with inner poly liners, or 1 Metric Ton (1000 kg) heavy-duty bulk Jumbo bags.
- **Primary Applications:** Raw feed material for activated carbon production kilns (air filtration, water purification, gold recovery extraction).

---

### Product 5: Pulverized Coconut Shell Charcoal Powder
- **Canonical URL:** https://rbnexim.com/product-charcoal-powder.html
- **HS Code:** 44029010
- **Granulometry:** Pulverized through air-swept micro-mills into ultra-fine mesh (200 mesh to 325 mesh).
- **Technical Parameters:**
  - Fixed Carbon: > 78.0%
  - Ash Content: < 3.5%
  - Moisture: < 6.0%
  - Methylene Blue Absorption: > 120 mg/g
  - Acid Soluble Matter: < 1.5%
- **Packaging:** 25 kg multi-layer Kraft paper bags with internal barrier liner to prevent dust migration.
- **Primary Applications:** Briquette manufacturing, hookah shisha binder matrices, agricultural biochar soil rejuvenation, metallurgical carbon additive.

---

### Product 6: Coconut Expeller Cake (Copra Meal Feed)
- **Canonical URL:** https://rbnexim.com/product-coconut-cake.html
- **HS Code:** 23065010
- **Origin:** Solid protein and fiber residue remaining after mechanical screw expelling of sun-dried coconut copra.
- **Nutritional & Feeding Analysis:**
  - Crude Protein: 18.0% – 22.0%
  - Residual Crude Fat / Oil: 7.0% – 10.0%
  - Crude Fiber: 10.0% – 12.0%
  - Moisture: < 8.0%
  - Total Digestible Nutrients (TDN): > 75.0%
  - Aflatoxin B1: < 20 ppb (Meets strict international animal feed safety thresholds)
- **Packaging:** 50 kg laminated PP bags or 1000 kg jumbo bags.
- **Benefits:** High rumen-bypass energy; proven to elevate milk yields and butterfat percentages in dairy cattle; premium digestible energy for swine and aquaculture feeds.

---

### Product 7: Commercial Refined & Cold-Pressed Castor Oil
- **Canonical URL:** https://rbnexim.com/product-castor-oil.html
- **HS Code:** 15153090 / 15153020
- **Grades Offered:** First Special Grade (FSG), Commercial Grade, Cold-Pressed Pure Castor Oil.
- **Technical Specifications:**
  - Ricinoleic Acid Purity: > 85.0% – 90.0%
  - Free Fatty Acids (FFA): < 0.50% (FSG) / < 1.5% (Commercial)
  - Hydroxyl Value: 160 – 168 mg KOH/g
  - Iodine Value: 82 – 90
  - Viscosity at 25°C: 9.5 – 10.5 Stokes
  - Color (Lovibond 1" cell): Y < 2.0, R < 0.4
- **Packaging:** 200 Liter (225 kg net) brand-new epoxied steel drums, 1000L IBC totes, 20ft flexitanks.

---

## 3. Commercial Export Documentation & Shipping Protocols
- **Incoterms 2020 Handled:**
  - **FOB (Free on Board):** Port of Mangalore, Port of Chennai, or Nhava Sheva (JNPT) Mumbai.
  - **CFR / CIF (Cost, Insurance & Freight):** Direct containerized liner delivery to Jebel Ali (UAE), Dammam/Jeddah (Saudi Arabia), Singapore, Port Klang (Malaysia), Rotterdam (Netherlands), Hamburg (Germany), New York/Savannah (USA).
- **Standard Export Documentation Provided:**
  1. Commercial Invoice & Packing List (Attested)
  2. Bill of Lading (Clean on Board Ocean B/L)
  3. Certificate of Origin (COO) issued by Chamber of Commerce / FIEO
  4. Certificate of Analysis (COA) for exact consignment batch parameters
  5. Phytosanitary Certificate issued by Ministry of Agriculture, India
  6. Non-GMO & Fumigation Certificates
  7. Third-party inspection reports (SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek) upon buyer request.
